name: Bow Rec Day Camp
description_short: Town run day camp at the Bow Rec Center for children entering kindergarten through grade 7, open 7:00 to 5:45 on weekdays for ten weeks. Days mix arts and crafts, STEM, sports, field games, water play and nature walks, with paid field trips twice a week for older campers.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds or credits for registration fees, deposits, camp fees or field trip fees. Field trip fees are refunded only if the trip is cancelled.

warnings: Resident rates (house rule pending): entering kindergarten $260 a week, entering grades 1 to 7 $220 a week, short weeks $176 or $208. Non-resident rates are used in the listing: $225 a week for grades 1 to 7 and $265 for kindergarten.

Hours are 7:00 to 5:45, with program activities 9:00 to 4:00, so before and after care is built into the day; extended_care is left blank because the camp does not call it out separately.
A Leader-In-Training program for students entering grade 8 costs $115 for the summer.
